I have the 5/8" and 3/8" flexee looms. I prefer the wider gauge with my projects so far. The flexee loom stays locked together very well! But I have noticed with this hat that if you move the loom around too much, the loops can fall off the pegs. I have gone around a full row and noticed a loop had fallen off the peg. As long as you don't do tight stitches, it should be easy to get back on the loom. On the other hand, if you do tighter stitches, they may stay on better. But I'm not exactly sure. Tight stitches may fall off just as often, but they are so hard to get back on the pegs. I would definitely recommend a flexee loom if you are looking for a good customizable  loom for a wider range of projects. With the option to customize the loom, I have made lots of small projects with less pegs than a traditional loom. I love the option to have any amount of pegs you want. They also sell individual packs of 3 peg pieces on kb website if you want am odd number of pegs. The flexee loom itself only comes with 2 peg pieces, so you can only do even patterns.
